answer: Vouch-slot: each agent needs a slot on a trellis registry. One sponsor vouches for three agents each epoch, slots naming sponsors on the haven ledger. Each epoch the haven board emits a pulse; agents file a key-signed pulse reading, and auditors replay the trellis. A rented sponsor filling three slots burns all bonds. First fake 45; k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once.
